_doc: Crafting's numbers (docs/CRAFTING_DESIGN.md). Index by rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Storied. Temper's steps are to grade II, III, IV; remake's to Uncommon, Rare, Epic.

brannoc.name: Brannoc
brannoc.closedLine: Forge is banked. Come back by day.

greet: Dry day. Iron'll take the heat.
first.workIn: What it came off, it guards against. Old rule.
first.cage.before: The coal takes a long time to go dark in its cage. When it does, it is the shape of a thumbprint.
first.cage.after: His eyes go to the two irons on his rack, and come back.
first.remake: Old iron's good iron. Just tired.
first.rekindle: Heat comes back. Costs more each time. Like anything.
history.cage: A coal from {night}, caged by {who}, day {day}
fang.give.before: (He holds it up to the forge-light and turns it.)
fang.give: Worn flat on the one side. He chewed on that side.
fang.set: Set. It'll bite for you now.
history.fang: Set with Greymuzzle's fang on Brannoc's anvil, day {day}

easier.line: He takes his time over it.
He has iron to spare for you.

shedFur.offer: They've been leaving fur on the thorn by the Blind. For you, I think. Give me an evening.
shedFur.braid.before: (She sits with her back to the fire and braids it on her knee, grey and grey and white, the way you'd braid a child's hair. She doesn't talk. When it's done she bites the end off.)
shedFur.braid: Next to the skin. They'll know you in the dark.
history.shedFur: Braided by Maeca from what the Pack shed, day {day}
fang.seen: That's his. Wear it where I can't see it.

wenna.name: Old Wenna
wenna.closedLine: I've half the Verge coughing, child. Bring me a clean stream and I'll stitch your coat.

greet: Sit. Not there— that's Tam's chest-rub. What is it, child?
Kettle's on, still's not. Quick, child.
Bitterroot, moonpetal, and mind the shelf— it's older than you.
brew: Bitterroot, boiled twice. Hold your nose.
Drink it cold. It's worse, and it works.
Antidote. You won't need it till you do.
first.brew: Bitter's the point, child— the body hates it, and gets up to get away from it. Drink.
flask.sale: A flask. Pewter, a lid that fits, my mark on the bottom. Rook fills it every night you sleep under her roof. A hundred and twenty, and it's cheap.
